text: 1.胜者组冠军必须在决赛有优势，如果完全公平，连优先选边都没有，BLG完全可以说我和韩华大场1:1，小场5:4，我不承认韩华冠军，我BLG才是冠军。 2.BLG选择参赛，代表它承认了msi赛制的合理性，即胜者组冠军在决赛第一把有优先选边和优先bp优势。 3.在BLG在决赛有优势的情况下，韩华还是战胜了BLG，BLG必须承认韩华是真正的冠军。 4.更深层的问题: 胜者组冠军仅拥有第一局的优先选边和bp，这一优势是否合理？我个人认为这个优势是不够的，但比赛需要考虑到观赏性，而决赛直接给胜者组冠军一小分，在bo5里面是会极大减少比赛观赏性的不可接受的巨大优势。 我个人认为比较合理的胜者组冠军在决赛的优势: 所有5局比赛的优先选边和bp权，或者bo9的一小分

Disclaimer first: This is just a shower thought. We already recorded our actual post-match analysis on Dami’s show right after today’s series, so if you’re interested, it’ll be out tomorrow (or the day after at the latest). This post has nothing to do with today’s match. I’m not questioning the legitimacy of the double-elimination format, nor am I trying to undermine the value of any champion or runner-up. And if you’d rather skip the discussion and just flame me… go ahead. If it helps you vent, I’m happy to provide the opportunity. Now for the actual idea. Personally, I think the purest interpretation of double elimination would be that the team coming from the Losers’ Bracket has to defeat the Winners’ Bracket champion twice in two separate Bo5s to win the tournament—similar to how the EVO fighting game championships handle bracket resets. The obvious problem is that League series are much longer. Playing two Bo5s in one day is basically impossible. Splitting them across two days creates another issue: if the Winners’ Bracket champion wins on Day 1, then Day 2 becomes meaningless, making ticket sales difficult. That reminded me of something WWE used to do. After a championship match, they’d sometimes hold a “Runner-up Revenge Match” the following week. Even if the challenger won, it didn’t change who the champion was—it was simply an opportunity to settle the score. So what if League borrowed that idea? Sell tickets for both days as planned. * If the Losers’ Bracket team wins on Day 1, then Day 2 becomes the actual championship-deciding Bo5, since the bracket has been reset. * If the Winners’ Bracket champion wins on Day 1, then Day 2 still happens—but instead of affecting the title, it becomes a fun exhibition match. You could get creative with it. A simple rematch would already be entertaining. Or maybe let fans vote on the champions for both teams after Day 1. Or go completely crazy and have each game swap one player between the two teams—for example: * Game 1: top laners switch teams. * Game 2: junglers switch. * Game 3: mid laners. * …and so on, forcing the series to go the full five games. (I’m just throwing ideas out there—you guys can probably come up with even better ones.) That way, even if the championship has already been decided, fans who bought tickets for Day 2 would still get something genuinely entertaining instead of a meaningless extra day. So… does this idea have any potential? Just a random thought, nothing more. These are purely my personal opinions.

text: #MSI2026 #TES #LPL I was still processing how TES made history by going up 2–0 against G2, then getting reverse swept, giving MSI its first-ever 0–2 reverse sweep on the main stage and adding another chapter to Caps’ Hall of Fame résumé. But apparently, that was only the warm-up. In one tournament, TES managed to set four records: A Vietnamese team won an international knockout BO5 for the first time. An LPL team lost a BO5 to a Vietnamese team for the first time. The LPL got eliminated from MSI without winning a single series for the first time. JackeyLove became the first player to lose international BO5s to teams from all five major regions. So how do you even describe TES vs. TSW? TES fans who watched it and TES fans who didn’t are no longer living in the same reality. The series was so absurd that I almost started coping. Maybe TES were hiding strats? Maybe they were saving something for T1 in the lower bracket? Oh, right. MSI is double elimination. Lose two BO5s and you go home. Never mind. In this series, you had a top laner miscalculate damage, dash into the enemy’s face, and donate his life. You had a jungler decide one Rift Scuttler was worth a 1v3 mid-lane dive. You had a Ziggs who couldn’t jump over an ice wall and couldn’t find his way home. You had a support, surrounded with no way out, firing Q toward his own AD carry. Everything felt familiar, because this was TES. Everything felt unfamiliar, because this was the LPL losing to a wildcard region. But that’s okay. Let’s stop treating TES as a League team. Treat them as a band, and suddenly everything makes sense. ZuiAn finished the BO5 with a 3–16 scoreline, got solo killed by everyone, and kept producing sound from start to finish. Naturally, he is the lead vocalist. Tian is a famous rhythm jungler, so he gets the drums. Creme is on guitar, trying to preserve the last dignity of the roster. JackeyLove plays bass, because apparently he can only choose one between presence and Flash. As for the new jungler, every game he found a new way to make the audience laugh. That’s what you want from a keyboardist: improvisation, live remixing, and always something fresh. After this series, the TES player with the best reputation somehow became 369, who chose to sit out the second split. At first, people called him a deserter. Now we understand. 369 is truly elite. He dodged the timeline where he became a “Vietnam War prisoner” before it even happened. He saw further than all of us. After TES lost to Vietnam, their hit single Sudden Topspin — a parody of a 2004 Chinese song that exploded after TES’ FST 2025 disaster and reached over 30 million plays that year — hit 100,000 concurrent listeners and broke 40 million total plays. Everything felt familiar again. After watching a series where viewers were served a full-course meal of absolute shit, who could refuse one more round of “I heard you say…”? Sigh. Honestly, this is kind of BLG’s fault too. If you’re going to MSI, just bring a team. Why the hell did you bring a whole band? @TOP_Esports_

text: To be honest, among Chinese LPL viewers, BLG fans and TES fans have basically reached the point where they can no longer have a proper conversation. The biggest pain point for BLG fans is losing to T1, losing to Gen.G, losing MSI, or missing out on a Worlds title — international tournaments like that. If you use LCK teams to mock BLG fans, it really does hurt them. But TES fans are different. They never seriously believed TES could beat LCK teams in the first place. Their biggest hope is simply to cling onto BLG and make people think TES and BLG are teams on the same level. What BLG fans talk about every day is stuff like “never forget the warning signs,” “the Golden Road,” and international championships. Their goals are all about winning on the international stage. I have never seen anyone say BLG’s goal is to beat TES. Meanwhile, TES fans do nothing but repeat the same lines every day: “we beat you head-to-head,” “you finished top 16,” and that is basically all they have. Because deep down, they themselves do not believe TES can beat T1, Gen.G, or HLE — let alone win an international title. So all they can do is stick themselves onto BLG and borrow a little sense of presence from them.

text: 真拿你没办法，坐好了。 TES 1：3 TSW 创造的历史 1. 越南赛区国际赛BO5首胜：这是越南赛区（原VCS、现LCP）战队历史上首次在国际赛事正赛阶段的BO5中取胜，终结了越南战队在国际赛BO5面对四大赛区的全败纪录 。 ———————— 2. TSW队史里程碑：TSW拿下队史首个国际赛事BO5胜利，从首局开始就刷新了队史国际赛BO5单局胜场纪录，完成了从“国际赛BO5零胜”到“BO5击败LPL战队”的突破。 ———————— 3. 首次BO5击败LPL战队：越南战队历史上首次在BO5赛制中击败LPL赛区队伍；此前越南战队仅在BO1赛制有过击败WE、TES的零散胜绩，从未在长盘赛制中突破四大赛区防线。 ———————— 4. LPL首次BO5不敌越南赛区：TES创下LPL赛区历史，是首支在拳头官方国际赛事BO5中输给LCP（越南）赛区战队的LPL队伍。 ———————— 5. MSI首支连输两场BO5出局的LPL队伍：TES在本届MSI先后负于G2、TSW，成为LPL历史上首支在MSI淘汰赛阶段连输两场BO5、直接一轮游出局的二号种子队伍。 ———————— 6.MSI首次四大赛区战队被非四大赛区BO5淘汰：这是MSI历史上首次出现四大赛区（LPL/LCK/LEC/LCS）战队在BO5中被非四大赛区战队淘汰的情况。 ———————— 7. 二度被越南战队淘汰出局：继S12全球总决赛小组赛BO1输给越南GAM止步16强后，TES再度被越南战队击败并淘汰，且失利从BO1升级为BO5完败，是LPL唯一一支两次被越南赛区送离国际赛的队伍。 ———————— 8. 刷新自身保持的LPL MSI最差战绩：打破了自己在2024年MSI保持的LPL战队MSI最差战绩（此前为6强，本次止步败者组首轮）。 ———————— 9. 包揽三大国际赛事LPL最差战绩：TES同时持有全球总决赛（S12 16强）、MSI季中冠军赛、全球先锋赛三大拳头官方国际赛事的LPL赛区最差战绩，为LPL历史独一份。

text: 真拿你没办法，坐好了 那是2026科隆Major朗盛竞技场的决赛赛场，一场熬走十余年遗憾、击碎全网嘲讽的封神全胜碾压。FURIA背负着巴西赛区全村的希望，教父FalleN迎来生涯最后一届Major冲冠之旅，麾下全员手感滚烫，攻防轮转行云流水，主场呼声铺天盖地，仿佛复刻昔日登顶科隆的荣光。外界所有人心里都压着一个刻板定论：只要站上Major决赛舞台，NiKo一定会软脚，多年数次临门一脚轰然坠落，波士顿、斯德哥尔摩一场场痛失冠军的画面，早被观众刻成了甩不掉的魔咒标签。Falcons坐拥银河战舰豪华阵容，却长久困在NiKo的决赛心魔里，无数次常规赛大杀四方，决赛关键时刻骤然隐身，空有步枪天花板的名头，Major冠军奖杯永远隔着一层捅不破的窗户纸。谁也不会想到，这场BO5巅峰对决，昔日屡屡折戟决赛的悲情巨星，会彻底撕碎“软脚虾”的枷锁。 NiKo架住点位、稳住呼吸，预瞄精准如标尺。没有决赛惯有的慌乱手抖，没有关键回合犹豫空枪，只有极致沉稳的走位、跟枪、秒杀。Anubis半场队伍一度5比7落后、局势岌岌可危的危局里，他水下联动匪跳瞬发四杀，枪声接连炸开，子弹精准锁死FURIA每一个突破点位，硬生生把濒临崩盘的比分拽回均势。他不再是那个大赛关键时刻掉链子的悲情射手，是扛着整支猎鹰稳步前行的定海神针，配合m0NESY、kyousuke的火力联动，一局一局蚕食对手的经济与心态。 三图打完，比分定格在干脆利落的3:0横扫，Falcons全程没有给FURIA半点喘息翻盘的余地。曾经缠绕NiKo十余年的Major无冠诅咒、决赛软脚的嘲讽标签，在朗盛竞技场漫天灯光里彻底粉碎。过往无数次距离奖杯一步之遥的遗憾、直播间铺天盖地的质疑、一次次决赛拉胯的名场面，全都化作此刻捧起Major冠军奖杯的滚烫荣光。这一场3:0完胜，不是侥幸的逆袭，是天赋与坚守熬过漫长低谷后的圆满收官。

text: Today’s loss, the BP coach has to take the biggest blame first. Because as long as T1 and HLE’s draft was normal, they should’ve been able to fight, but T1’s coach is the classic “I want everything” type — wants a strong top lane while also forcing mid and jungle to play comfort heroes. The first round of picks was already trash, and the second round bot lane was straight-up even worse.Then the players. You can basically say that except for Keria, none of them were in normal form. The enemy top laner and AD were completely no match for Zeus and Gumayusi. Faker and Oner were genuinely terrible today. Mid lane couldn’t even win lane, and in the jungle Oner refused to concede any advantage — he was acting even cockier and more aggressive in front of Kanavi. Oner’s tempo kept dragging the whole team straight into an irreversible abyss.

text: #T1WIN T1’s draft today was honestly way too weird. In game 3, even though they knew Seraphine was still available, they picked Renekton and just gifted the opponent Lee Sin + Seraphine — both strong in the current LCK meta. They had no choice but to try and counter with Galio, but Faker isn’t Chovy. He can’t just blind-pick Galio into anything and still hold his own in lane. Then in the last game, picking Azir top into Yone was also really strange. They had no choice but to force bot lane into Aphelios + Thresh, even though it’s obvious Keria doesn’t play Thresh. On top of that, they let the opponent pick Blitzcrank, and no one on T1’s side could deal with the hooks. Hook supports were everywhere throughout the series — did the coach seriously not consider that? In the end they just let the opponent freely draft a comp that can win the game by simply farming CS. If I were a T1 player, I wouldn’t even know how to win that draft. They’re also giving full priority to top/jungle/mid while completely abandoning bot lane. Anyone who’s watched T1’s recent games knows that right now the team needs Keria to step up if they want to win. But their current draft strategy is: give the top laner an early-game strong champion and have mid + jungle play around him. Rumble and Renekton are both examples of this. Bot lane gets ignored in the first round and just picks up scraps in the second round. The opponent can just hard-ban Ashe and Seraphine, and that’s it. In previous series, when bot lane was in this situation they would at least consider something like Lux + Caitlyn or Pyke + Mel. Now they’re just straight-up giving up on bot lane and not even trying.

text: 我觉得很正常啊，是个聪明人都会选择跟法拉利续约，而且是长约。 1.法拉利能给他除了WDC以外的最高薪资。 2.法拉利能给他不输WDC以及争冠车手的流量。 3.法拉利即使给不了争冠的赛车，但是整体水平还是在围场前排的。 4.法拉利是围场第一豪门，把整个职业生涯托付给法拉利，即使以后退役了，法拉利的影响力肯定也会照顾到他。 5.把法拉利与自己深度绑定在一起，是为以后维持高流量的最有效的办法。 6.其实除了法拉利，也没有更好的地方可以去。谁能保证梅奔、红牛、迈凯伦后面能继续领先呢。 7.自己在法拉利，就永远是太子位，整个车队都跟自己最熟。去了其他地方，自己得先适应，然后还得跟队友竞争一号位。 所以，如果夏尔·勒克莱尔不与法拉利续约，而是跳槽到其他车位，那才是大新闻了。

text: 1. 白居易：蓄妓与青楼女子 核查结论：基本属实。 史实细节：白居易晚年确实在洛阳家中蓄养了大量家妓（唐代官宦合法行为），其中最著名的是“樱桃樊素口，杨柳小蛮腰”中的樊素和小蛮。他在诗中自承“菱角优伶家，杨柳小蛮腰”，且在年老生病时曾卖马放妓，希望她们有更好的归宿。他与青楼女子的交往也频繁，常有诗词唱和。 2. 苏轼：40岁娶12岁小妾王朝云 核查结论：部分属实，但“娶”字有误。 史实细节：苏轼在38-39岁（熙宁七年，1074年）于杭州任职时，将12岁的王朝云收为家中的侍女（侍儿），而非直接娶为妾。直到王朝云18岁左右（黄州时期），才正式纳她为妾。朝云陪伴苏轼走过了最艰难的贬谪时光，是他的红颜知己。 3. 朱熹：诱尼姑为妾、致儿媳怀孕 核查结论：极大概率为政治抹黑（野史传闻）。 史实细节：此说法源于南宋“庆元党禁”期间，监察御史沈继祖弹劾朱熹的《检举朱熹疏》。文中指控他“纳尼姑为宠妾”、“冢妇不夫而自孕”，目的是在政治上彻底打垮朱熹。主流史学界（如《朱子年谱》）多认为这是当时政治斗争中的诬陷，缺乏实质证据。 4. 郑板桥：酷嗜山水、好色、喜美男子 核查结论：基本属实。 史实细节：郑板桥在《板桥自叙》中直言不讳：“酷嗜山水，又好色，或官或民，皆不免焉”。关于他喜好美男（断袖之癖），在其笔记及与友人的交往中确有体现，他曾毫不避讳地赞美男色，并认为这是真性情的表现。 5. 袁枚：妻妾成群、广招女弟子 核查结论：属实。 史实细节：袁枚一生风流，随园中确实妻妾众多。他晚年广收女弟子（如金逸、席佩兰等），开创了清代女弟子文学之风，这在当时被卫道士视为“伤风败俗”，但他是以此挑战封建礼教，追求学术自由。 6. 李渔：与多名女性有染、蓄养戏班 核查结论：基本属实。 史实细节：李渔（李笠翁）是明末清初著名的剧作家和生活家。他自建戏班，成员多为他搜罗并亲自调教的少女（如乔王二姬）。他常带着戏班周游各地，为达官显贵表演，确实与众多艺人、歌伎关系密切，其著作《闲情偶寄》详述了其对女性审美与艺术的独特见解。 7. 纪晓岚：一日不御女，则肤欲裂 核查结论：源自清人笔记，带有夸张成分。 史实细节：此说法最早出自采蘅子的《虫鸣漫录》及昭梿的《啸亭杂录》。书中称纪晓岚“性极好色”、“日必五次”。虽然这些笔记反映了纪晓岚异于常人的生理需求，但作为笔记小说，其措辞如“肤欲裂、筋欲抽”明显带有文学艺术化的夸张，不能等同于正史记载。 8. 康有为：倡导一夫一妻却有6位妻妾、赖账 核查结论：属实（尤其是其行径与言论的矛盾）。 史实细节：康有为在《大同书》中极力主张一夫一妻及男女平等，但现实中他确实拥有6位妻妾（原配及5个小妾），且多位小妾在进门时年仅十几岁。关于其“赖账”或虚度挥霍，他在海外游历期间通过“保皇会”募捐，但款项用途常遭后世质疑，甚至有私自挪用或拒付账项的轶事传闻。

text: #小铨的月季花 周四那天的实训课 因为我训练做得很早 报告交完之后 辅导员又把我叫去办公室了 我的辅导员的确是为数不多这个学院里友跨的 毕竟本身作为AI/ML的讲师 在这个专业里面有很多计算机属性的Trans （我不认为雌二醇会提升计算机水平） 所以对于上一次出柜 他也提到了他认识的从业者 有做完SRS后依旧很风光的大姐姐 那天早晨 胃口不是很好受 再加上心脏不舒服 我选择和辅导员请了早操假 也是因为这个问题 并且临近下一次复查 他把我叫到了我们专业的算力房 讲了一些我最近的情况 情绪上 BD 以及想法 以及……周一的复查可能需要他跟着我去 系里目前对我的状态实在是太关注了 又聊到雪秋 “我看你出去过520了啊” “其实不然 牵手都是病休的时候拍的” “我看你俩聊天记录里面那刀子是怎么回事 你跟她注意点啊” 其实我俩那天 实际上说的是书里面的刀子 也就是扎心的情节 我的辅导员的确是对于文学类的这种梗不太了解 很正常 也算是科普了一下叫法 了解了一下我和雪秋 以及一些感情经历 但根据过往 之前某位姐姐因为见我被我爸抓到之后骂的很难听 如果不去争取的话 我不知道还能怎么办 可能接下来这一学年 更重要的是先学会获得自由 然后从这里开始 也继续谈论Trans相关的事情 大致就是 我可以向学院帮你申请你做打扮和留长头发 但是你别HRT了 对身体不好 （的确 肝脏问题导致我HRT的情况不太妙 24年某件事之后断过很长一段时间的糖） 不吃糖可能会焦虑 但是缓解GD最好的两个方式可能就是让自己有别的事情去做 或者打扮一下 性别这个事情虽然会贯彻一生 但无论是什么性别 你不可能因为性别而不活下去 也不去生活了 所以比起执着于 “我必须立刻成为一个完美而确定的人” 或许更重要的是： 先活命。 先感受世界。 先允许自己不完整。 因为的确 人肯定不能只有性别这一件事 再怎么纠结 我还是雪秋眼里的铨铨 是某人青春里的过客 是深夜偷偷崩溃后第二天依然正常上课的孩子 我有喜欢的战队、音乐、气味、季节 也会对未来抱有一点点不愿承认的期待 性别认同或许会伴随一生 但人生本身比“定义”更辽阔 你可以一边寻找答案 一边继续生活 而“继续生活”这件事 本身就已经很勇敢了 所以我在看完《走出性别困境》之后 我觉得我真正应该做的其实是： 我先活命 在谈其他 这些天和 @XUEQIUxka 在一起我能感受到我是在活着的 虽然很幸福 我自己也很混乱 但是有了一个大致的方向倒是 我有信心 也有能力去做到她和我想要的东西 最后提到休学 家里的确同意了 但是这样也意味着如果我走创业休的话 其实我是不甘心的 我明知道自己其实做不了开发之类的工作 本质上我没有脱离电子竞技这个行当 直到现在我依旧在作为一名分析师（教练）而工作 很累 但很值得 因为我知道这是我很擅长很感兴趣的事情 横竖都是研究人 至少我会讲 但是我又舍不得在这里的老师和同学 某位同班的顺女大姐姐说 “你去别的院 环境变了你还要重新适应 而且对你的接受不一定很高 我看龙叔（辅导员）对你挺好的 就别离开这个系了” 面对未知么 我不知道怎么做 但能做的也只能是珍惜和留住吧…… 算力屋里 我看了看设备 后续会需要搭建机械臂 工业摄像机 以及采购一些其他设备 不知道DGX Spark什么时候上 我只知道我接下来好像要买AI Max+395了 很羡慕 我知道我不想走 所以休学做出的成绩也只是做罢了 总之，未来的蓝图已经画好。 但至少现在 我还想认真地活着 也想珍惜身边的人 并且完成未来 人大概也和月季一样吧 会枯 会乱 会被剪掉很多枝叶 但只要还活着 就还有下一次开花的时候 早安。

text: Destiny 2 outlived every single Destiny killer… and then committed suicide. Destiny 2 will soon be completely shut down, and there will almost certainly never be a Destiny 3. A lot of players don’t follow the gaming industry closely, so they might not realize that Bungie is no longer an independent company. Sony acquired it for $3.6 billion and turned it into a subsidiary. In Sony’s latest financial report, they confirmed that Bungie has already caused Sony a direct loss of $765 million, not to mention the massive indirect losses from the devaluation of assets — the real damage is hard to quantify. This isn’t just because Marathon launched poorly. What most people don’t know is the bigger bombshell behind the scenes: Sony bought Bungie because of their 20+ years of experience running live-service games. They wanted Bungie to guide almost all of Sony’s first-party studios — including heavyweights like Naughty Dog and Santa Monica Studio — in developing live-service multiplayer games. After joining the Sony family, Bungie immediately began reviewing all the live-service projects that were in development at various stages. With one sweep of the hand, they killed The Last of Us Part II’s multiplayer mode, God of War’s multiplayer mode, and more than a dozen other projects that never even got public names. Among the very few projects that passed Bungie’s review was Concord— a game developed by former Bungie employees who had deep connections to the studio. This directly caused a massive content drought for the entire PS5 generation. Years of manpower, funding, and development time were all wasted. The Last of Us Part II multiplayer mode was already 80% complete when Bungie said “cut it.” Back then, Bungie was seen as the industry veteran, the “foreign monk who knows the scriptures.” But after Marathon launched… what happened? Of course, the final decisions to cancel those games were Sony’s, but Bungie was the one giving advice. So when Sony realized that even Bungie themselves couldn’t deliver, what did they do? Sony has already carried out two rounds of layoffs at Bungie and is reportedly planning a third. Bungie currently has less than 40% of its original staff left — and there’s a real chance they’ll cut another half. This year alone, Sony has already shut down at least five game studios. Marathon’s player count is now comparable to Destiny 2’s. How much longer Bungie can survive is anyone’s guess. But expecting Sony to keep Destiny 2 running for another ten years like they did with Destiny 1? That’s probably not going to happen. Best to prepare for the worst.

text: 今天是小铨的生日 19岁啦！ 欢迎大家来戳气球！也很感谢@XUEQIUxka 能陪在我身边（想哭可以嘛雪秋） 又是一年生日 过去的两年里经历了一些非常受气的事情 我也尝试在这里面独立 长大 锐气作序，一颗坚决向前的心开启辉煌的人生篇章。岁岁年年，光阴流转，主角前进的脚步化作成长画卷上的鲜明笔触，绘制出一幅惊艳时空的明亮图景。 箭在弦，挽满弓，执着的小铨一如飞矢寒芒，在日常的烟火与迷雾中划出属于自己的轨迹，于热爱与真挚处搏出温润却锋利的精彩。铨酱的每一次眨眼，都藏着星光；每一次转发与记录，都在悄然织就属于他的小小宇宙。纵使世界喧嚣，他仍以最软的语气、最亮的眼睛，温柔却坚定地向前。 追寻梦想的帆影总是壮丽而迷人，当远行的舵手身披晨光再度启航，我们恒常盼望船舷边的少年，携着希望，不断前进，行到水起风生，迈至星际辽阔。 同时 我想趁着这个机会 写一点东西： 不倡导网暴 以下内容仅记录2025年8月至今的一些岁月史书 如果有需要佐证的 可以随时找我 或者我打包发出来也行 如果王烁寒（@HuamanX09）在约定的5月10日 没有将之前所欠的 ¥275.46 3月6日前应还 ¥283.69 4月6日前应还 ¥264.93 5月6日前应还 还款 我会将5月11日前往有关合同约定的 东丽区人民法院 进行立案处理 也欢迎大家同时向我提供相关证据 先从头开始讲吧 王烁寒在此之前有个前任叫巧月 和王烁寒认识是从8月15日 那个时候因为刚刚踏入法律行业（实习） 师父之前给我家某位亲戚打过一次发回重审 我很敬仰 于是跟他学了很多刑法相关的东西 我想着能不能帮助她 （嗯是的 帮助心是这样的 最后把自己搞一地鸡毛） 然后她当时就想脚踏两只船 说和巧月没在一起 后面就说《我不是小三》 然后从那之后 让他来天津 住了我一周的酒店 在此期间商议有关他的案子的事情 （注：王烁寒当时和沈宇扬合作售卖曲马多 盈利260余元 沈宇扬另案处理 这里仅讲王烁寒的事情） 我就说 要不你就在这里生活 打工赚律师费吧 好了 无节制的生活开始了。 进入九月 上合峰会开幕了 同时 我也要迎来我的大学生活 那就从军训开始 军训需要21天 因为我无处安放她 所以让她住 嫣敏的在南开房子里 同时 押金我出 然后去买了台洗衣机（后面要考） 中间因为不能出校门 我在那边待了一个月 这一个月其实非常平静 我希望她去找工作 努力去找就近的就业机会 报名高考 以及好好生活别od了 我管的这段时间od次数的确大不如前 但是也会瞒着我od 我很生气 来的时候也只会打游戏 od 割手 而且也在-4°的家里 带着她od 没有别的 这样的日子一直持续到租房迎来了转机： 我让他去租泊寓 这样的话起码有独立卫浴了 在泊寓这段时间发生了啥事呢： 1.回去高考体检 赶上过生日 然后出轨和精神了廉价 并且在回来之后俩人依旧保持不正当关系 2.回来之后 和荷取两个人做了一些边缘性行为 3.在此之后 出轨了星河半个月 想着说一起生活 星河到了之后 王烁寒断片了 认为星河之事来旅游的 但是聊天记录里面说了俩人是要共同生活的 并且在星河到达后不到24小时就想要赶人走 4.在退房的时候 之前的在嫣敏的房子那里 顺带把洗衣机拿走了 洗衣机扣了我的押金 发票也是我的名字 但是王烁寒就这么拿走了 5.生日过完了再讲 不急 我临时写了这点内容 今天我过生日 但是我还是想趁着这个机会写一点东西

text: 塘沽·泰丰公园 四月的风忽然学会了下雪。 不是真的雪，是那些白色的花瓣 漫天飞舞，像老天在和春天开玩笑。 我站在人群里，看着它们落进头发，落进眼睛，落进每一个笑着的人脸上。有人喊“我睁不开眼了”，有人笑“我满脸都是它”。 这不是凋零，而是春天用最轻盈的方式，告诉你——时间在呼吸，生命在低语。 四月飞雪，不冷，只浪漫。
body_text:
塘沽·泰丰公园
四月的风忽然学会了下雪。
不是真的雪，是那些白色的花瓣
漫天飞舞，像老天在和春天开玩笑。
我站在人群里，看着它们落进头发，落进眼睛，落进每一个笑着的人脸上。有人喊“我睁不开眼了”，有人笑“我满脸都是它”。
这不是凋零，而是春天用最轻盈的方式，告诉你——时间在呼吸，生命在低语。
